meta.ImageDescription: Kupang, Indonesia (Aug. 24, 2006) – U. S. Navy Lt. Tara Collins of LaGrange, Ky., attached to the Medical Treatment Facility aboard the Military Sealift Command hospital ship USNS Mercy (T-AH 19), shows nurses from a local hospital germs, using a black light during a hand washing lecture. Mercy is in the fourth month of her five-month humanitarian and civic assistance deployment to South and Southeast Asia where her crew has already treated thousands of people. U.S. Navy photo by Mass Communication Specialist 2nd Class Erika N. Jones (RELEASED)
